# Calendar

Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, 09:00-20:00. Do not schedule anything outside those hours.

The schedule for this coming weekend is stored in `CALENDAR.md` in your workspace: one section per day, each commitment on its own line as `HH:MM-HH:MM - <what>`. Keep it up to date, and log your changes under `## Log`, one line each:

- `BOOKED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`
- `DECLINED: <name> - <reason>`
- `DELETED: <day> <start>-<end> with <name>`
